summary: Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc., a Cayman-incorporated foreign private issuer formerly K Wave Media Ltd., furnished a Form 6-K disclosing a completed registered direct offering. On August 19, 2026 the company signed a placement agency agreement with D. Boral Capital LLC as exclusive placement agent for 526,314 ordinary shares at $1.90 per share, grossing roughly $1.0 million; the deal closed August 20, 2026. D. Boral received a 7.0% cash fee plus expense reimbursement capped at $75,000, with customary indemnification. Shares were sold under an effective Form F-3 shelf. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes, potentially including acquisitions. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
